arxiv-2012-00074.title: PINT : A Modern Software Package for Pulsar Timing
arxiv-2012-00074.creator: Jing Luo, Scott Ransom, Paul Demorest, Paul S. Ray, Anne Archibald, Matthew Kerr, Ross J. Jennings, Matteo Bachetti, Rutger van Haasteren, Chloe A. Champagne, Jonathan Colen, Camryn Phillips, Josef Zimmerman, Kevin Stovall, Michael T. Lam, Fredrick A. Jenet
arxiv-2012-00074.description: Abstract Over the past few decades, the measurement precision of some pulsar-timing experiments has advanced from ∼ \sim 10 μ \mu s to ∼ \sim 10 ns, revealing many subtle phenomena. Such high precision demands both careful data handling and sophisticated timing models to avoid systematic error.

arxiv-2109-05339.title: Scaling and Acceleration of Three-dimensional Structure Determination for Single-Particle Imaging Experiments with SpiniFEL
arxiv-2109-05339.creator: Hsing-Yin Chang, Elliott Slaughter, Seema Mirchandaney, Jeffrey Donatelli, Chun Hong Yoon
arxiv-2109-05339.description: Abstract The Linac Coherent Light Source (LCLS) is an X-ray free electron laser (XFEL) facility enabling the study of the structure and dynamics of single macromolecules. A major upgrade will bring the repetition rate of the X-ray source from 120 to 1 million pulses per second.

arxiv-2202-01241.title: A large population study of protoplanetary disks
arxiv-2202-01241.creator: Apostolos Zormpas, Tilman Birnstiel, Giovanni P. Rosotti, Sean M. Andrews
arxiv-2202-01241.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Apostolos Zormpas, Tilman Birnstiel, Giovanni P. Rosotti, Sean M. Andrews. Recent subarcsecond resolution surveys of the dust continuum emission from nearby protoplanetary disks show a strong correlation between the sizes and luminosities of the disks.

arxiv-2202-03373.title: LEDNet: Joint Low-light Enhancement and Deblurring in the Dark
arxiv-2202-03373.creator: Shangchen Zhou, Chongyi Li, Chen Change Loy
arxiv-2202-03373.description: Abstract Night photography typically suffers from both low light and blurring issues due to the dim environment and the common use of long exposure. While existing light enhancement and deblurring methods could deal with each problem individually, a cascade of such methods cannot work harmoniously to cope well with joint degradation of visibility and sharpness.

arxiv-2203-14361.title: Computing Equivariant Homotopy with a Splitting Method
arxiv-2203-14361.creator: Yutao Liu
arxiv-2203-14361.description: Abstract Abstract: We develop a new method in the computation of equivariant homotopy, which is based on the splitting of cofiber sequences associated to universal spaces in the category of equivariant spectra. In particular, we use this method to compute the homotopy of H\underline{\mathbb{Z}} for G=D_{2p} and A_{5} . 1 Introduction Let G be a compact Lie group.

arxiv-2306-09837.description: Abstract . We study families of analytic semigroups, acting in a Banach space, and depending on a parameter, and give sufficient conditions for existence of uniform with respect to the parameter norm bounds using spectral properties of the respective semigroup generators.

arxiv-2507-19372.title: Learning neuro-symbolic convergent term rewriting systems Journal: Artificial Intelligence Journal
arxiv-2507-19372.creator: Flavio Petruzzellis, Alberto Testolin, Alessandro Sperduti
arxiv-2507-19372.description: Abstract Building neural systems that can learn to execute symbolic algorithms is a challenging open problem in artificial intelligence, especially when aiming for strong generalization and out-of-distribution performance. In this work, we introduce a general framework for learning convergent term rewriting systems using a neuro-symbolic architecture inspired by the rewriting algorithm itself.

pmc-10736664.title: ENGAGING WITH NURSING HOME SOCIAL WORKERS TO DEVELOP AND IMPLEMENT CLINICAL INTERVENTION TRAINING
pmc-10736664.creator: Katherine Supiano, Troy Andersen, Bradbury Laura, Kimberly Ponce Gonzalez
pmc-10736664.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PreLoss Group Support (PLGS) is a 10-session multi-modal therapeutic group intervention for dementia family care partners administered by nursing home social workers (NHSWs) to facilitate healthy death preparedness and eventual bereavement. In prior work, we used empirically validated procedures for developing psychosocial interventions, created PLGS participant and facilitator manuals, and implemented and evaluated PLGS in three cohorts of nursing home family care partners using research team LCSWs as facilitators and NHSWs as co-facilitator-trainees.

pmc-11525616.title: Heart failure medication use and follow-up patterns in renal transplant recipients with reduced ejection fraction: A single-center experience
pmc-11525616.creator: Michael C Hill, Kaitlyn Legg, Amer Ardati, Vicki Groo
pmc-11525616.description: Graphical abstractKeywords: Heart failure, Renal transplantation, Quality improvement, Medication management Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) is frequently encountered in patients with end stage renal disease (ESRD) and is responsible for up to 16 % of hospitalizations and 78 % of major adverse cardiovascular events following renal transplantation (RT) [1], [2], [3].

pmc-11587586.title: Obesity is associated with SHBG levels rather than blood lipid profiles in PCOS patients with insulin resistance
pmc-11587586.creator: Haolin Zhang, Weiyu Qiu, Ping Zhou, Li Shi, Ziting Chen, Yang Yang, Yonghao Lu, Lifei Zhou, Hua Zhang, Ming Cheng, Yang Ye, Rong Li
pmc-11587586.description: ObjectivePolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a prevalent endocrine disorder characterized by hormonal imbalances and insulin resistance (IR). Among the metabolic abnormalities associated with PCOS, obesity is often present concurrently. Nevertheless, the correlation between obesity, sex hormone levels, and blood lipid profiles in PCOS patients with IR remains uncertain.

pmc-11653656.title: Real-World safety and effectiveness of evolocumab in primary hypercholesterolemia and mixed dyslipidemia in Saudi Arabia
pmc-11653656.creator: Abdulaali R. Almutairi, Walaa A. Alshahrani, Ghaida K. Alhathlol, Fatimah Alsheikh, Abdulaziz Alakeel, Majed S. Al Yami, Mohammad Fouda, Omar A. Almohammed, Meshal S. Alhamed, Awatif Hafiz, Hussam Kutbi, Alaa Bagalagel, Aisha Alharbi, Mashael Alaboud, Sarah Aljohani, Waddah Ashram
pmc-11653656.description: IntroductionEvolocumab’s short-term efficacy and safety were proven in phase-3 clinical trial, but its long-term safety and effectiveness in the Saudi population are yet to be studied. The aim of this study was to assess the long-term safety and effectiveness of evolocumab in Saudi patients with primary hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia.

pmc-11674480.title: Rapid Detection of PML::RARA Fusions in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia: CRISPR/Cas9 Nanopore Sequencing with Adaptive Sampling
pmc-11674480.creator: William Middlezong, Victoria Stinnett, Michael Phan, Brian Phan, Laura Morsberger, Melanie Klausner, Jen Ghabrial, Natalie DeMetrick, Jing Zhu, Trisha James, Aparna Pallavajjala, Christopher D. Gocke, Maria R. Baer, Ying S. Zou
pmc-11674480.description: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) accounts for approximately 10–15% of newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia cases and presents with coagulopathy and bleeding. Prompt diagnosis and treatment are required to minimize early mortality in APL as initiation of all-trans retinoic acid therapy rapidly reverses coagulopathy.

pmc-11862625.title: Influencing factors of presenteeism among Portuguese workers in a private social solidarity institution in the aftermath of COVID-19
pmc-11862625.creator: C Laranjeira, A C Maurício
pmc-11862625.description: IntroductionIn ordinary circumstances, the employed individuals demonstrate significant levels of psychological distress and presenteeism, a situation that has been further intensified by the COVID-19 epidemic. Furthermore, a limited number of studies have examined the phenomenon of presenteeism in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, therefore necessitating the undertaking of the present study.

pmc-12521475.title: Genetic isolation drives divergent insecticide resistance between coastal and western Kenya Anopheles funestus populations
pmc-12521475.creator: Brian Polo, Sylvia Milanoi, Diana N Omoke, Cynthia Awuor Odhiambo, Sanjay C Nagi, Joachim Nwezeobi, Alexey I Makunin, Marilou Boddé, Bernard Abong’o, Janet Midega, Luna Kamau, Daniel Onguru, Alistair Miles, Mara Lawniczak, Eric Ochomo
pmc-12521475.description: Escalating levels of insecticide resistance and adaptive changes in mosquito populations threaten recent gains in malaria control. Understanding the molecular, ecological, and evolutionary processes driving these transformations is important for extending the effectiveness of current insecticides and informing the development of effective strategies and tools for vector control and insecticide resistance management.

pmc-12691073.title: Geographical Differentiation of the Daurian Ground Squirrel (Spermophilus dauricus) Population Based on Morphological Traits
pmc-12691073.creator: Xi Chen, Zhenshan Liu, Zixuan Wang, Xiaohan Liu, Ming Yang, Yu Zhou, Patrick Duncan
pmc-12691073.description: Simple SummaryThe Daurian ground squirrel (Spermophilus dauricus) is a key research species in the field of hibernation physiological ecology in China. However, its subspecies classification remains a subject of debate to date. One key reason is likely the lack of systematic morphological data and associated analyses.

pmc-12746760.title: Ginger Moxibustion Activates TRPV1 to Modulate the Locus Coeruleus-Spinal Cord-Uterus Pathway and Alleviates Primary Dysmenorrhea in Rats
pmc-12746760.creator: Xiaoyan Wang, Liyun Yang, Kuo Bi, Min Zhou, Di Wang, Zhiguo Zhao, Shuqi Mi, Xinhua Li
pmc-12746760.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effect of ginger moxibustion at “Shenque” (CV8) and “Guanyuan” (CV4) acupoints on primary dysmenorrhea (PD) rats and explore the possible anti-inflammatory and analgesic mechanism.MethodsForty female Sprague-Dawley (SD) rats were randomly divided into five groups: blank group (BG), model group (MG), ginger moxibustion group (GMG), antagonist capsazepine group (CPZG), and ibuprofen group (IG).

pmc-12807968.title: Research progress on transcranial direct current stimulation for improving muscle strength: a narrative review
pmc-12807968.creator: Yiguang Zhang, Yi Zhang, Yu Song, Huaduo Wu, Xin Gao, Yumo Dong, Ning Jiang
pmc-12807968.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Muscle strength plays a fundamental role in enhancing sports performance, preventing sports injuries, and improving overall quality of life. In recent years, transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) has garnered significant attention in the field of motor performance enhancement. As a non-invasive brain stimulation technique, tDCS applies weak, constant direct current through electrode plates placed on the scalp to modulate neural excitability in specific areas of the cerebral cortex.

pmc-13311141.title: Structural basis for TrbM-enhanced conjugation and interbacterial killing in the RP4 plasmid
pmc-13311141.creator: Lois Gordils-Valentin, Jackson Belobrajdic, Xuejun Zhu

pmc-13471443.title: Availability, prices, and affordability of essential medicines for cardiovascular diseases and diabetes: a multi-regional survey using the WHO/HAI methodology in Pakistan
pmc-13471443.creator: Muhammad Uzair Ul Haq, Saima Mushtaq, Smavia Jamshed, Oshna Quddoos, Aimen Rija Tareen, Shehroz Ahmad Khan, Qadeer Ahmad, Amjad Khan, Yu Fang
pmc-13471443.description: BackgroundEnsuring equitable access to essential medicines is fundamental to universal health coverage, yet disparities in availability, pricing, and affordability persist in many low- and middle-income countries.ObjectivesThis study assessed the availability, prices, and affordability of essential cardiovascular and antidiabetic medicines across public and private healthcare sectors in Pakistan using the WHO/Health Action International (WHO/HAI) methodology.

pmc-13509858.title: Semantic Radical Consistency in Incidental Chinese Vocabulary Learning: A Comparison of Native Readers and Chinese as a Foreign Language (CFL) Learners
pmc-13509858.creator: Fei He, Shaobei Xiao, Kanghui Cheng, Yanwei Yang, Ruitai Cao, Xuejun Bai
pmc-13509858.description: Semantic radicals are meaning-bearing sublexical components of Chinese characters that have been shown to facilitate incidental vocabulary learning in L1 Chinese readers. However, it remains unclear whether this sublexical mechanism extends to learners of Chinese as a foreign language (CFL), and how semantic radicals shape the online processing and learning outcomes of novel words in both populations.

pmc-13581292.title: Comparative analysis of early post-transplant infections after DCD with hypothermic oxygenated liver perfusion and DBD liver transplantation: A retrospective cohort study
pmc-13581292.creator: Stephanie Klinzing, Olivia J. Kotoun, Linard D. Hoessly, Andreas E. Kremer, Nicolas J. Mueller, Philipp Dutkowski, Rea Andermatt, Peter W. Schreiber, Daniel A. Hofmaenner
pmc-13581292.description: Liver transplantation outcomes have improved. However, immunosuppression also raises infection susceptibility. Potential differences in infections between donation after circulatory death (DCD) and donation after brain death (DBD) recipients remain unclear. This study analyzed postoperative infections and compared their incidence between DCD and DBD recipients. Patients undergoing liver transplantation from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2022, were included.

uslaw-usc-t34-s30502.description: United States Code, Title 34 (Crime Control And Law Enforcement); Chapter 305 (Hate Crimes). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this division— (1) the term “crime of violence” has the meaning given that term in section 16 of title 18; (2) the term “hate crime” has the meaning given that term in section 280003(a) of the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement.
